setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays the four-step phrase (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device at 90 BPM, Rate /1. Only Song slot 1 is filled, Song mode is at its default On and playback is stopped. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8) and tap fader cell (2,7) on the Song page, then tap (8,7) seven times: Song Playback reads Global length 8, so one pass of a slot lasts 8 steps (about 1.3 seconds).
steps.title: Shorten the song to 8 steps

steps.caption: Hold slot 1 at (1,1), press slot 2 at (2,1) and release; tap (2,1) to select slot 2. Press Channel (3,8) and tap octave +1 at (11,8), then press Song (6,8). Turn E1 to Song tasks, E2 to Slot setup and press K3, turn E3 up one detent and press K3: Repeats reads 2 for slot 2.
steps.title: Copy slot 1 to slot 2 an octave higher with Repeats 2

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8), tap slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play (1,8). Slot 1 is bright and plays C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65); Song Playback reads Pass 1 / 1. Watch the MIDI strip "MIDI sent in this step": each note is one sixth of a second after the last.
steps.title: Play slot 1 once

steps.caption: Let playback reach slot 2. Its LED becomes bright and Playback reads Pass 1 / 2. This output window begins with the remaining C, D, E, F of slot 1; the octave-higher C, D, E, F (MIDI 72, 74, 76, 77) then marks the change into slot 2. Slot 1 lasts eight global steps, even though its four-step channel motif repeats twice.
steps.title: Slot 2, first of two passes

steps.caption: Slot 2 stays bright and plays the same octave-higher phrase again; Song Playback reads Pass 2 / 2. Repeats held the slot for exactly two passes.
steps.title: Slot 2, second pass

steps.caption: Let slot 2 finish its second eight-step pass. Empty slot 3 returns the song to slot 1: its LED is bright and Playback reads Pass 1 / 1. This output window begins with the end of slot 2, then drops to C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) on slot 1. Press Stop at (1,8).
steps.title: The song loops back to slot 1
